ko.title: AgenticRag-R1: 다단계 추론과 검색을 위한 스택 메모리 기반 에이전트 강화학습
ko.hook: 복잡하고 다단계인 추론 및 검색 한계를 극복하는 최신 RAG 강화학습 아키텍처를 도입하세요.

en.title: AgenticRag-R1: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Stack Memory for Multi-Step Reasoning
en.hook: Implement advanced RAG reinforcement learning to overcome complex, multi-step reasoning and dynamic retrieval bottlenecks.
key_takeaways: Advanced multi-step reasoning and dynamic retrieval using stack memory
Simultaneous improvement of factuality and memorization in RAG systems
Optimization of retrieve-generate pipelines via agentic reinforcement learning

key_takeaways: 利用栈内存推进多步推理与动态检索的深度优化

通过智能体强化学习优化检索-生成全链路
